description:
Get a link that opens a token launch on chaindaddy.io, filled in

Returns only a chaindaddy.io `url` that opens the launch form with the token's name, ticker, chain and launch contract filled in, and a one-line `summary` of it. It creates nothing: nothing is launched, stored, paid for or signed by this call. The person reviews every field on the page and confirms the launch in their own wallet there. `venue` is `chaindaddy-launchpad`, the default: Chain Daddy's launchpad, which launches the token with its own locked trading pool, nothing up front and its registration free, on EVM chains and Solana. Or `chaindaddy-classic`: a plain token from Chain Daddy's factory (no pool, a one-time fee, registration included). Any other venue is refused (400).

A launchpad launch on an EVM chain can keep part of the supply for a team, locked: `teamPercent` (up to 20), split with other people (`teamMember`), on one schedule or up to four (`teamSchedule`). The link fills the form's team row in, and the person checks every wallet and schedule there before confirming; none of it can be changed once the token is created. One the launch would refuse is refused here (400). Solana's team share and schedule are fixed, and a plain token has none at launch, so both refuse these three.

chain.description: The chain to launch on, as a key (base, ethereum, solana, ...) or chain id; the person can add more on the page

symbol.description: The ticker, up to 16 characters (a leading $ is dropped)

teamMember.description: People the team's tokens are split with, up to 9, each as `<wallet or handle>:<percent of the team's tokens>`: `0xabc…:30`, `@name:20`, `discord:name:10`. The launching wallet keeps the rest. A handle works once its owner has signed in with that account on Chain Daddy. Needs `teamPercent`.

teamPercent.description: Percent of supply kept for the team, locked, from 0.01 to 20. Alone, all of it goes to the launching wallet, a part every month for 6 months

teamSchedule.description: When the team's tokens unlock, up to 4 schedules. Each is `week:<weeks>` (a part every week, 4 weeks or more), `month:<months>` (a part every 30 days, 2 months or more) or `days:<wait>:<last day>` (nothing for `wait` days, 7 or more, then steadily until the last day, 28 or later). The first keeps the rest of the team's tokens; every other one adds `/share:<percent of the team's tokens>`. A schedule is for everyone, by their split, unless it adds `/for:<people>`, a comma list where 0 is the launching wallet and 1, 2, … are the `teamMember` entries in order. Example: `week:4` and `month:12/share:75/for:1` unlock a quarter every week for 4 weeks for everyone, and the rest every month for 12 months for the first `teamMember`. Needs `teamPercent`.

venue.description: chaindaddy-launchpad (the default, Chain Daddy's launchpad) or chaindaddy-classic (a plain token from Chain Daddy's factory)

name: prepare_token_launch

summary.description: One line saying what the link opens

url.description: The chaindaddy.io page to open, filled in. Nothing has been created.

title: Prepare a token launch link
